sentences.japanese: 君のめがねが床に落ちたよ。
sentences.english: Your glasses fell on the floor.

sentences.japanese: 私はひざを曲げずに両方の手のひらを床に付けることができる。
sentences.english: I can place the palms of my hands on the floor without bending my knees.

sentences.japanese: 鏡の破片が床に散乱していた。
sentences.english: Fragments of the mirror were scattered on the floor.

sentences.japanese: 机を動かそうとしたら、足が床に引っ掛かっていたらしくガーッという音がした。
sentences.english: When I tried to move the desk, one of its legs made a jarring sound as it scraped across the floor.
